intent: for a band name, write one paragraph about the band and list its albums, with the facts of its English Wikipedia article only

out.text: one paragraph, the albums as title (year), and the URL of the article

rules.label: Longest paragraph
rules.note: an earlier form of this tool had the limit only in the text of a step; the model wrote 142 words for a limit of 120

rules.label: Most rewrites of the paragraph
rules.note: the regression set has a case that needs one rewrite; no case needed more than two

rules.label: Most albums in the list
rules.note: longer lists were mostly singles and live albums

rules.label: Search results to look at
rules.note: a live run for a famous band gave a list page as the first result; the step now prefers the title that is the name

rules.label: Time to wait for each request
rules.note: the two services answered in under two seconds; ten leaves room for a slow day

flow.name: Find the article
flow.do: search English Wikipedia for the band name; take the result with the name of the band, else the first result

flow.name: Article found
flow.ensure: the search answered, and it found an article in at most {search.results} results

flow.name: Read the article
flow.do: read the summary and the Discography section of the article; if the page only lists the meanings of the name, read the article name (band)

flow.name: The article has the name of the band
flow.ensure: the title of the article is the name of the band, with or without a word in brackets

notes.text: a run with a real model: a search for a name that is no band gave the article of a politician; the judge gate saw it, and now code sees it first

flow.name: The article is about the band
flow.brief: pass if the description and the summary are about a music group with this name; fail if they are about a person, a place, a film or another thing

fail.when: the article is not about the band

notes.text: candidate for code: the description of the article often has the word band

flow.name: Albums found
flow.ensure: the Discography section lists at least one album

flow.name: Write the paragraph
flow.do: write one paragraph about the band, of at most {answer.max_words} words, with facts of the summary only; if you see problems, fix them; give the paragraph as the result

flow.name: Short enough
flow.ensure: the paragraph has at most {answer.max_words} words, and it is not empty

fail.when: the paragraph is too long or empty

flow.name: Only facts of the article
flow.brief: compare the paragraph with the summary; fail if the paragraph states a fact that the summary does not have, and name that fact in why

fail.when: the paragraph has a fact that is not in the summary

flow.name: A rewrite is left
flow.ensure: the paragraph was written at most {answer.rounds} times after the first

flow.name: Compose the answer
flow.do: join the paragraph, at most {albums.max} albums as title (year), and the URL of the article
